label: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B SBC
description: BCM2711 quad-core Cortex-A72 SBC with one true gigabit Ethernet port (PCIe-attached, not USB-bridged) and dual-band 2x2 802.11ac Wi-Fi with Bluetooth 5.0.
notes: Wireless/BT are absent on the cheaper SKUs sold as 'Pi 4 Model B (no wireless)'; this spec models the standard board. Single RJ45, so router duties are limited to VLAN trunking.
